question: Find the name and overall rating of the player with the highest potential among those under 180 cm tall and having a sprint speed of at least 95, based on attributes recorded between 2013 and 2015. Also include the date of the attribute record and their age at that time, calculated as the difference in years between the record date and birthday.

prediction.sql:
SELECT t1."XCL_123", t2."XCL_132", t2."XCL_131",
       CAST(strftime('%Y', t2."XCL_131") AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', t1."XCL_125") AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player AS t1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1."XCL_122" = t2."XCL_130"
WHERE t1."XCL_126" < 180
  AND t2."XCL_151" >= 95
  AND t2."XCL_131" >= '2013-01-01'
  AND t2."XCL_131" < '2016-01-01'
ORDER BY t2."XCL_133" DESC
LIMIT 1
